parts.name: statement

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Beschränken Sie den Zugriff auf kritische Systeme ad-hoc.

parts.name: assessment

parts.name: statement

parts.name: guidance

parts.name: statement

parts.name: guidance

parts.name: guidance

parts.name: assessment

parts.name: statement

parts.name: guidance

parts.name: assessment

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Änderungen werden sporadisch in Textdateien notiert.

parts.name: guidance

parts.name: assessment

parts.name: assessment

parts.name: statement

parts.name: guidance

parts.name: assessment

parts.name: statement

parts.name: guidance

parts.name: assessment

parts.name: statement

parts.name: guidance

parts.name: assessment

parts.name: statement

parts.name: guidance

parts.name: assessment

parts.name: guidance

parts.name: assessment

parts.name: statement

parts.name: guidance

parts.name: assessment

parts.name: statement

parts.prose: Bewerten Sie die Effektivität der automatischen Testfallaktualisierung.
